title: Dry-season tomato buying stays firm
content: Traders in Central Luzon reported steady demand for tomato and a favorable harvest pace. Supply looked adequate rather than scarce.

title: Field rain slows some tomato picking
content: A burst of rain and a local flood warning delayed harvest on a few tomato plots. Traders called the damage limited.

title: Maize prices hold near the monthly average
content: Maize prices were stable and local demand from feed mills was described as adequate.

title: Palay buying continues with government support
content: A subsidy and procurement support kept rice selling interest stable. Farmers described the buying price as adequate.

title: Onion supply concerns return before planting
content: Traders talked about a shortage risk if the dry season is disrupted. Price volatility and possible losses were mentioned more than export demand.

title: Cold storage onion stocks are still moving
content: Stored onion continued to sell. The note was cautious but not a report of blight or flood damage.

title: Eggplant demand improves at the trading post
content: Eggplant demand improved and the harvest was described as favorable. Prices were firm without a shortage.

title: Laguna tomato supply looks adequate
content: Tomato supply in Laguna was adequate and prices were stable.

title: Pangasinan rice fields watch typhoon tracks
content: A typhoon watch raised the chance of flood damage in rice areas of Pangasinan. Farmers were urged to protect stored palay.

title: Ilocos maize export interest is small but positive
content: A modest export inquiry supported maize sentiment. Traders still called the move limited.
